subject: design/pipeline-measurement-v2
statement: do not self-maintain prices (`#D-7`, O-4). Consume an existing, actively-maintained cross-provider pricing source (LiteLLM's `model_prices_and_context_window.json` is the de-facto, MIT-licensed, covering Anthropic/OpenAI/…), **vendored + pinned** (parsed with stdlib `encoding/json` — vendored *data*, not a code dependency), refreshed by a pinned re-vendor script (the mermaid/lavish idiom). This preserves the no-new-egress/offline posture (no runtime fetch) and controls supply-chain surface. Each record stamps the pinned snapshot version (DINV-6); an un-priced model is flagged (UB-2), never silently $0. Cost is a thin derived layer over the ground-truth token counts.
